lines.text: Lebanon is told to open its doors so fire can consume its cedars, and the oaks of Bashan wail.
The LORD tells the prophet to pasture the flock marked for slaughter, and he takes two staffs named Favor and Union.
In one month the prophet dismisses three shepherds, then cuts the staff called Favor in two, revoking the covenant with Egypt.
They weigh out thirty pieces of silver as wages, and the prophet throws them to the high priest in the house of the LORD.
The LORD says He will raise up a worthless shepherd who deserts the flock, and he calls for a sword to strike his arm and right eye.
